summary.added_external_crate_count_note: All eight are the trybuild compile-fail harness and its transitive closure. toml_datetime, toml_parser, winnow, and serde_core are also in that closure and are already in the lock through the toml_edit admitted by P2-K1, so they are not re-admitted here.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: The projected/actual isolation is a claim about what will not compile. Asserting it in prose leaves nothing that fails when the seal opens, and asserting it with a source grep passes for a crate that links the writer and simply has not named it yet. trybuild is the only way to put the claim in front of a compiler and pin the diagnostic, which is what makes an accidental accessor a red test. It runs as a dev-dependency of one crate, is never linked into a product binary, and cannot be reached from any shipping edge.
network_posture: No admitted package opens a socket, reads an environment secret, or runs an install script. trybuild invokes the pinned cargo toolchain against a scratch project under CARGO_TARGET_DIR; CI populates the registry with cargo fetch --locked before the offline test run, so the harness itself performs no fetch.
advisory_path: RustSec and crates.io advisories, GitHub security advisories, and upstream release notices, triaged as reviewed commits through this same admission process. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request, so no automatic bump can bypass the review.

admissions.name: glob
admissions.role: build-time only, never linked into a product binary
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Expands the tests/compile_fail/*.rs case pattern for trybuild.

admissions.name: serde_spanned
admissions.role: build-time only, never linked into a product binary
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Span-carrying serde adapter required by toml.

admissions.name: target-triple
admissions.role: build-time only, never linked into a product binary
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Supplies the host triple trybuild stamps into the scratch project it compiles each case in.

admissions.name: termcolor
admissions.role: build-time only, never linked into a product binary
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Colours the trybuild diff. Writes to the test process stdout and nothing else.

admissions.name: toml
admissions.role: build-time only, never linked into a product binary
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: trybuild writes the scratch project manifest with it. Same toml-rs generation the already-admitted toml_edit resolves to, so no second parser enters the lock.

admissions.name: toml_writer
admissions.role: build-time only, never linked into a product binary
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Serialiser half of toml, used to emit that manifest.

admissions.name: trybuild
admissions.role: build-time only, never linked into a product binary
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: The suite that proves the projected/actual type isolation. It compiles each tests/compile_fail case in a scratch project and requires the committed diagnostic, so a seal that grew an exit is a failing test rather than a silent pass. Dev-only on academic-scenario; no product crate can reach it.

admissions.name: winapi-util
admissions.role: build-time only, never linked into a product binary
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Windows console-handle helper behind termcolor. It is the reviewed unsafe-FFI pattern already admitted for windows-sys, in a dev-only crate.
